## objective
N: bundled Gemma model in the native app (served from the app bundle, no user download), fetch script, licence notice
- discovery: Run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` first. No new dependencies. Read src/offline/gemma.ts (task O: OPFS import + lazy MediaPipe load), src/screens/Settings.tsx (offline tutor section), capacitor.config.ts and package.json scripts (task Q), vite.config.ts (PWA precache, task P), .gitignore and .vercelignore.

Human ask (2026-10-10 13:20): "when you download the app from TestFlight or the App Store the model should come with it so the user does not touch any of that." Approach for today: ship the model file inside the native app bundle. Capacitor serves everything in dist/ from the app's local origin, so a file at public/models/gemma3-1b-it-int4-web.task ends up at https://localhost/models/gemma3-1b-it-int4-web.task inside the iOS app and MediaPipe can load it straight from that URL (modelAssetPath), no OPFS copy, no download. The web deployment never gets the file (it is ignored for git and Vercel), so the web app keeps the existing file picker / VITE_GEMMA_MODEL_URL paths.

1. src/offline/gemma.ts: add a "bundled" source. On first status()/ensureLoaded(): `fetch(BUNDLED_URL, {method: "HEAD"})` where BUNDLED_URL = "/models/gemma3-1b-it-int4-web.task" (resolved against location.origin); if it answers 200 (or 206), the state becomes "ready" with `source: "bundled"` once ensureLoaded has created the LlmInference with modelAssetPath = that URL; if it fails (404, network error, non-http origin), fall through to the existing OPFS / URL logic unchanged. Cache the probe result for the session. Expose `source: "bundled" | "opfs" | "url" | null` in status(). Tests: bundled HEAD 200 -> ready after ensureLoaded without touching OPFS; HEAD 404 -> existing behaviour; HEAD rejects -> existing behaviour.
2. src/screens/Settings.tsx: when source is "bundled", the offline tutor section shows "ready, built into the app" and hides the file input and the remove button. Keep the other states exactly as they are. Extend Settings.test.tsx for the bundled state.
3. public/models/README.md (committed): what goes here, the exact file name, the licence line (Gemma is distributed under the Gemma Terms of Use; the app must show the notice and the prohibited-use policy link), and the fetch command. .gitignore: `public/models/*.task` and `public/models/*.litertlm`. .vercelignore: `public/models/`. vite.config.ts: make sure the PWA precache glob never includes .task/.litertlm (globIgnores) so the service worker does not try to cache 700 MB.
4. scripts/fetch-model.sh (committed, executable): downloads the file from Hugging Face into public/models/ using the `hf` CLI if present (`hf download litert-community/Gemma3-1B-IT gemma3-1b-it-int4-web.task --local-dir public/models`) else curl with an HF_TOKEN env (`https://huggingface.co/litert-community/Gemma3-1B-IT/resolve/main/gemma3-1b-it-int4-web.task`), prints the licence reminder first, verifies the size is above 600 MB, never prints the token. package.json: `"model:fetch": "sh scripts/fetch-model.sh"`; `ios:build` stays as is but prints a one-line warning when public/models has no .task file (`node -e` check before vite build; do not fail the build).
5. Settings "about" area or the offline section: a one-line "on-device model: Gemma 3 1B, Gemma Terms of Use" with a link to https://ai.google.dev/gemma/terms (only when source is bundled or a model is installed).
6. README: in the Offline mode section add "Bundled in the iOS app": the fetch command, that the file ships inside the IPA (about 700 MB, so the App Store marks it as a large download), the licence notice requirement, and the later upgrade path (Apple Background Assets essential downloads, which fetch the model from your own host during App Store installation so the IPA stays small). docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: one paragraph on the three model sources.
Gate: all existing tests green, tsc, lint; `pnpm build` exits 0 with and without a dummy file in public/models/ (create a 1 KB dummy for the check, then delete it; do not commit it).

- src/screens/Settings.test.tsx covers the bundled state (no file input, no remove button, the built-in text) and the licence line
- .gitignore ignores public/models/*.task and *.litertlm; .vercelignore lists public/models/; vite PWA config ignores .task and .litertlm in the precache; scripts/fetch-model.sh exists and is executable; package.json has model:fetch
- README Offline mode section has the 'Bundled in the iOS app' subsection with the fetch command and the Gemma Terms of Use notice

#!/bin/sh
# Downloads the Gemma 3 1B web model into public/models/ so the native app ships it.
# Uses the hf CLI when present, else curl with HF_TOKEN (the repo is gated).
set -eu

REPO="litert-community/Gemma3-1B-IT"
FILE="gemma3-1b-it-int4-web.task"
DIR="public/models"
MIN_BYTES=600000000

cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."

echo "Gemma is provided under the Gemma Terms of Use: https://ai.google.dev/gemma/terms"
echo "Prohibited use policy: https://ai.google.dev/gemma/prohibited_use_policy"
echo "Accept the licence on https://huggingface.co/$REPO first. The app must show this notice."
echo

mkdir -p "$DIR"

if command -v hf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  hf download "$REPO" "$FILE" --local-dir "$DIR"
else
  if [ -z "${HF_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
    echo "error: no hf CLI and HF_TOKEN is not set" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  # The token goes through a header file on stdin so it never shows up in ps or output.
  printf 'Authorization: Bearer %s\n' "$HF_TOKEN" |
    curl -fL --progress-bar -H @- -o "$DIR/$FILE.part" \
      "https://huggingface.co/$REPO/resolve/main/$FILE"
  mv "$DIR/$FILE.part" "$DIR/$FILE"
fi

size=$(wc -c < "$DIR/$FILE" | tr -d ' ')
if [ "$size" -le "$MIN_BYTES" ]; then
  echo "error: $DIR/$FILE is $size bytes, expected more than 600 MB" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "ok: $DIR/$FILE ($size bytes)"
EOF
chmod +x scripts/fetch-model.sh

- Fetch it: `pnpm model:fetch` (runs `scripts/fetch-model.sh`; uses the `hf` CLI if installed, else curl with `HF_TOKEN`).
- Not in git (`.gitignore`), not deployed to Vercel (`.vercelignore`), never precached by the service worker. The web app keeps the file picker in Settings.

Licence: Gemma is distributed under the [Gemma Terms of Use](https://ai.google.dev/gemma/terms). The app must show that notice and link the [prohibited use policy](https://ai.google.dev/gemma/prohibited_use_policy); Settings does so in the offline tutor section.

#!/bin/sh
# Downloads the Gemma 3 1B web model into public/models/ so the native app ships it.

FILE="gemma3-1b-it-int4-web.task"
DIR="public/models"
MIN_BYTES=600000000

  printf 'Authorization: Bearer %s\n' "$HF_TOKEN" |
    curl -fL --progress-bar -H @- -o "$DIR/$FILE.part" \

  mv "$DIR/$FILE.part" "$DIR/$FILE"
fi

size=$(wc -c < "$DIR/$FILE" | tr -d ' ')
